portInfo.description: South Carolina Ports Authority has long run Charleston cruise operations at Union Pier Terminal (32 Washington Street). The passenger FAQ PDF describes on-site parking, complimentary shuttles to the terminal door, Gate 2 at Concord & Laurens for cars, Gate 1/main gate at 32 Washington for taxi/bus drop-off, and CHS airport about 10 miles with 20–30 minutes travel time. SCSPA’s published Jan–Jul 2026 cruise calendar lists multiple calls (e.g., Vision of the Seas, Norwegian Jewel, Valiant Lady) with the last tabulated Jewel call on 30 June 2026. Separately, the Union Pier facility page now states UPT is under contract to be sold to Marti Holdings LLC for waterfront redevelopment so SC Ports can focus on cargo. Until SCSPA publishes a successor passenger address, treat the landing as uncertain after mid-2026 and verify sailing documents.

climate.description: Humid subtropical climate with hot, humid summers and mild winters

politics.visaRequirements: Visa-free for citizens of Visa Waiver Program countries (ESTA required). Others need visa.
politics.entryRequirements: Valid passport required. ESTA required for visa-free countries. Some nationalities need visa.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Per FAQ (Union Pier era). I-26 Exit 219-B; brown/white CRUISE signs; Gate 2 Concord/Laurens for cars; Gate 1 at 32 Washington for taxi/bus. Parking. On SCSPA property; shuttle to door; fees listed in FAQ subject to change. CHS. ~10 miles; 20–30 minutes. After sale. Successor directions Not verified.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.
